title: EpiRWE Oncology Analytics Handbook
text:
This driver is required to connect R to Redshift.
Navigate to https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/jdbc20-download-driver.html
Download from the link “JDBC 4.2–compatible driver version 2.x (without the AWS SDK)”. The file that downloads should be named like this: “redshift-jdbc42-2.xx.xx.jar”
Move the downloaded .jar file out of your Downloads folder to a suitable location in your file system.




install.packages("DBI")
install.packages("rJava")
install.packages("RJDBC")
install.packages("rstudioapi")
